_why: Every cutout in this directory is derived from a product's own PDP photograph, and the
derivation is not obvious: each product needs its own key tolerance and its own crop, and
getting either wrong is invisible until the asset is composited onto a coloured frame.
The first eight cutouts were cut by hand and took three rebuilds to get right (6fbe0c0 -
96b9185 - 6d48994), because the numbers lived in a shell history nobody kept.
This file is those numbers. `node scripts/rebuild-cutouts.mjs` regenerates every entry
from its source photograph, so a cutout is reproducible rather than a one-off artefact.
The original eight (lotion, deodorant, toothpaste, bar soap) are deliberately NOT listed:
they predate scripts/cut-component.mjs and re-cutting them would change the bytes of
assets already composited into five shipped galleries. The script reproduces the lotion
to within 3px of the hand-cut version, so bringing them in is safe whenever those frames

_fields.fuzz: Backdrop flood tolerance, % of full scale. White-on-white products need it LOW or the flood walks through the product's own body: the foaming hand soap keys its bottle out at 1.5% because the white foam behind it bridges to the white backdrop.
_fields.seed: A pixel unambiguously ON the product. Selects which connected component to keep, which is what drops the MADE IN THE USA badge and the staged spare units.
_fields.band: Rows proven to contain ONLY the product. Left/right are measured from these, never estimated.
_fields.x: Explicit left,right, for photographs where no product-only row exists because the swoosh wraps the product at every height. Measured off the pixel where the tan swoosh gives way to the product edge.
_fields.taper: Y,LEFT,RIGHT - above row Y, clip to LEFT..RIGHT. For products whose top is narrower than their body (a jar lid, a pump), where the rectangular crop would otherwise keep whatever sits in the notch beside it.
_fields.top: Explicit top edge, where the swoosh crosses above the product's own top inside the x band.
_fields.bottom: Explicit contact line, for photographs whose reflection fades out at constant width instead of opening back up - there is no waist to find and the scan correctly declines to invent one.

cutouts.note: Swoosh wraps the jar at every height, so x is stated, not measured from a band. Jar edge is x=425: the tan swoosh reads 248,235,216 out to x=424 and the jar's shaded edge takes over at 426.
Same staging and same jar position as the Pure Unscented shot.
Three more tubes are staged bottom-right; they are a separate component and the seed drops them. The reflection fades at constant width, so the contact line is stated.

The lowest fuzz in the library. White bottle, white foam behind it, white backdrop: at 1.5% the flood crosses the foam into the bottle and punches a hole through the body that a thumbnail does not show.
